title: Lab 4 — Cluster Upgrade with kubeadm (v1.36 to v1.37)
description: Perform a real minor upgrade: the scenario provisions a v1.36 cluster, and you repoint the Kubernetes apt repo and upgrade it to v1.37 in the recommended order.

steps.title: Step 1: Check what you are actually running
Step 2: Point apt at the target minor, then upgrade kubeadm
Step 3: Plan and apply on the control plane
Step 5: Upgrade kubelet and kubectl on the control plane
Step 6: Repeat on the worker (two-node environments)
